4:
An idolatrous midwife may not deliver a Jewish woman in private, even if she is an expert.
Likewise, she may not nurse the child of a Jew in her own house, even if others are standing by.
However, in the house of a Jew, she is permitted to deliver or to nurse, if others are standing by or if people are going in and out, provided that she is not left alone with the child at night.
